# Original helpers for the private direct Expr pass

`original-rows.json` has nineteen authentic helper roles plus the original
`Lean.instantiateExprMVarsImp` extern as negative capability evidence. The native
extern is not registered. `execution-rows.json` contains the exact finite
FAP/PAP closure of the nineteen helper roots: 111 declarations, 310,018 raw CAS
bytes, no initialized dependencies. This is a small helper fixture, not a
frontend image or a completed two-pass Expr instantiator.

Each raw CAS row was SHA-256 verified and its exact typed Name checked against
the accepted producer index pinned in `provenance.json`. Only optional top-level
`pretty` was removed. Source is pinned Lean `819816b2`; source/index/row/file
hashes are recorded in provenance. Upstream Apache 2.0 terms are in `LICENSE`.

`delayed-layout-row.json` separately preserves the original compiled
`Lean.assignDelayedMVar._redArg._lam_0` constructor layout evidence: the
DelayedMetavarAssignment record has tag0/two object fields/no scalars. This row
is not included in the execution closure or presented as the monadic assignment
API used by tests. The test-only `model-swap-expr-delayed-maps` adapter swaps
context slots8/9 around actual generic guest map assignment, and
`model-delayed-record` supplies the proven record layout. These are labeled
storage models; original delayed getters/accessors still execute their actual IR.

`model-setup-*` functions copy source constructor algorithms under distinct Names
to prepare inputs without preparing a helper whose CodeRequest is under test.
Explicit body replacements test control/owner failures, not original source
admission. There is no native oracle or native performance/heartbeat claim here.
See [the runtime report](../../../research/JAVA_EXPR_DIRECT_PASS.md).
